kurz: Strong radiant heat from below gives crust and smoky flavour. With a hot zone and a cool zone, thick pieces work too.
bild_im_kopf: Like sun and shade on the grill.
was_passiert: Above the embers the heat is very strong and browns quickly. Next to them it is gentler; there the inside cooks without burning. Dripping fat burns in the embers and makes smoke.
schritte: Push the embers to one side: a hot and a cool zone.
Preheat and clean the grate well.
Bring thick pieces up to temperature indirectly first, then brown them directly.
